form.notes: Line 22 is the recognized gain that escapes deferral (boot). Its destination is conditional and the instructions say so verbatim: 'Report a gain from the exchange of property used in a trade or business (and other noncapital assets) on Form 4797, line 5 or line 16. Report a gain from the exchange of capital assets according to the Schedule D (Form 1040) instructions for your tax return.' A like-kind exchange DEFERS gain (line 24) — the deferred part reaches no line this year at all.
